note: Each entry BREAKS one guard and names the assertion that must catch it. The yield is weak TESTS far more than weak code - see memory/mutation-tests-find-weak-tests.md. Add an entry whenever you add a guard. ⚠ NOT FILED: 'a plan step returning nil does not overwrite the row'. Treating nil as a verdict wipes the row only MOMENTARILY - every current plan's final step returns a real observation and restores it - so the damage lasts only if a plan's LAST step returns nil, which no experiment does. The guard is defensive and its assertion is kept; no mutation could bite, so none is filed.

mutations.what: ★ THE HARD LINE: no PUSH call may reach a read-only probe
mutations.replace:
if false then SetCVar("nameplateShowEnemies", 1) end
        local pending = {}
mutations.expect: PUSH CALL IN A READ-ONLY PROBE
mutations.why: Deliberately placed inside `if false` so the mutation can never execute a client write even if a restore failed - the smoke scans the FILE, so it fires anyway. Proving the scan works must not cost the safety it is scanning for.
